comment: The mark before a layer row's three locks opens the layer's note. The docker holds Hills, Sky with a note, Layer 1 and the Background, and Hills is active. The pointer rests on Hills' dimmed mark, whose tooltip says what its press does. A press on Sky's lit mark, the second row's, makes Sky active and opens Rename Layer on it with the keyboard in the note, which the rename_dialog step reads as the focus and a typed key proves by landing after the note's last word. Cancel, then Rename... from the row's menu opens on the name as it always did, and a press on Layer 1's dimmed mark after it still puts the keyboard in the note. The marks sit at x 222 to 240 of the docker's own space, rows 31 apart from y 47, so the presses below are those centres plus the docker's place.

layer.comment: The sky, painted too blue on purpose.
